{{Quote|One day on Kamino and I'm already swimming in my armor.|[[Unidentified stormtrooper (Timira City)|Unidentified stormtrooper]]|<ref name="TFU2vg" />}}
'''Timira City''' was a [[City/Legends|city]] located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] and site of a clandestine [[Cloning/Legends|cloning]] [[Timira City Cloning Facility|facility]] for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Although the Empire vastly expanded its cloning program beyond Kamino, it still retained as a site for cloning operations.

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Timira City became the secret location of a hidden project initiated by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]]. With the [[Death/Legends|death]] of [[Galen Marek]], Vader's former [[Sith apprentice/Legends|secret apprentice]], the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] Lord sought to create a new version of his fallen disciple via [[Cloning/Legends|cloning]].

==History==
{{Quote|As if the troop morale wasn't low enough already, this place is making all of us crazy.|[[Unidentified stormtrooper (Timira City)|Unidentified stormtrooper]]|<ref name="TFU2vg" />}}
After the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] concluded in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] with the ascension of [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]], [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]], as [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|emperor]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]] swiftly proceeded to implement total [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] control over the known [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]].<ref name="EpisodeIII">{{Film|III}}</ref> [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]], the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] responsible for the creation of the Emperor's [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|clone army]], was ironically subjugated by the native [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoans]]' [[Clone trooper/Legends|own creations]] in the name of the Empire.<ref name="BattlefrontII">''[[Star Wars: Battlefront II]]''</ref> By [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]], almost two decades after the [[Declaration of a New Order]], Kamino was a heavily guarded world protected by [[Imperial Military/Legends|military]] assets such as [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Imperial warships]] and a large [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] garrison.<ref name="TFU2vg" /> The garrison force included an Imperial [[Battalion/Legends|battalion]], filled with enlisted troopers, led by [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Cody/Legends|Cody]], a first generation clone of [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] and a veteran of the Clone Wars. On a lesser note, the stormtroopers who guarded Timira City regarded it as a miserable assignment, which ultimately had a negative impact on the troop morale.<ref name="Databank">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]'' in-game databank</ref>

[[File:TFUII-concept_5.png|thumb|left|250px|The cloning facility within Timira City]]
Due to the planet's importance, Kamino's [[Cloning/Legends|cloning]] facilities, the Empire's most valuable possessions on the [[Ocean/Legends|ocean]]-covered world, was naturally subjected to a heavy presence of Imperial [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]] and [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]]; Timira City was no exception.<ref name="TFU2vg" /> Although the Empire vastly expanded its cloning program beyond Kamino, the original source of the clone army, Kamino still retained much of its importance as a clandestine site for the Imperial cloning operation, which thus earned the planet its sizable military garrison. Clones were still produced en mass to serve as [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]], but no longer as the defenders of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]]. Instead, they were grown and programmed to become the [[Clone stormtrooper|faceless enforcers]] of the Galactic Empire.<ref name="BattlefrontII" /> In Timira City, Imperial scientists endeavored to improve the Kaminoan method of cloning, and eventually created the highly experimental "accelerated cloning process." With this new procedure, the growth rate of clone subjects was immensely hastened to the point where they could reach adulthood in a mere few weeks. However, the accelerated cloning process was wrought with imperfections, and was thus responsible for the creation of extremely unstable clones, none of which were able to survive for very long.<ref name="TFU2comic">[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II (graphic novel)|''Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II'' graphic novel]]</ref>

The known [[Clone template/Legends|genetic source material]] for the accelerated clones came from two subjects: [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] and [[Galen Marek]]. The side-effects caused by the flaws in the accelerated cloning process notwithstanding, the selection of Fett and Marek as templates also contributed to the creation of failed experiments.<ref name="TFU2comic" /> The fact that Boba Fett was not conceived by natural process, but was rather himself a clone, undermined the process; clones bred from a clone source were exposed to even greater risks of genetic anomalies.<ref name="TrueColors">''[[Republic Commando: True Colors]]''</ref> As for Galen Marek, the fact that his blood was [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] made it almost impossible for a stable clone to be created from his genetic material. Although the exact nature of the instability was unclear, it was believed that [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] was responsible, and thus a Force-sensitive had never been successfully cloned in the past.<ref name="JediVsSith">[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']]</ref><ref name="TFU2vg" />

Hence, Timira City was the location of entire stocks of psychologically deranged Fett clones and [[Aberrant clone|aberrant freaks]] bred from the Marek template.<ref name="TFU2vg" /><ref name="TFU2comic" /> The individual responsible for the inclusion of Marek's DNA as a genetic source material was none other than the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], Marek's former [[Sith Master/Legends|master]]. Through painstaking efforts, Vader endeavored to create the ultimate [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] and [[Sith assassin/Legends|assassin]]: a new version of Galen Marek; a clone who possessed all of the original apprentice's strengths, but none of his weaknesses. Over the course of six months, Vader occasionally visited Timira City in order to personally oversee the progress of his secret experiment, only to be disappointed by a variety of imperfect clones. In spite of a laboriously slow rate of improvement, each clone was psychologically flawed in one way or another, mostly due to the emotional attachments that they inherited from Vader's deceased apprentice. As a result, the clones were eventually driven into a [[Clone madness|state of madness]], and thus none of them were deemed suitable to replace Marek at Vader's side.<ref name="TFU2vg" />

[[File:Starkiller_Kamino.png|thumb|right|250px|Starkiller single-handedly eliminates scores of Imperial stormtroopers throughout Timira City.]]
Eventually, however, [[Subject 1138|one clone in particular]] had proven stable enough for Darth Vader to hope that the project would finally become a success. But like the others who came before, the clone was unable to resist the controlling influence of his progenitor's memories, the [[Memory flash|imprints]] used to train the clone. After developing an obsession with [[Juno Eclipse/Legends|Juno Eclipse]], the [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] whom Galen Marek fell in love with prior to his [[Death/Legends|death]], the clone [[Escape from Kamino (1 BBY)|escaped]] from his creator's custody and embarked on a single-minded quest to find Eclipse.<ref name="TFU2vg" /> But despite the loss of a wayward clone, Vader was greatly pleased by the ultimate outcome of [[Dark Apprentice|another clone subject]]. Unlike all of his precursors who preceded him, this clone successfully compartmentalized all of Marek's memories, which enabled him to distinguish himself as a unique individual, separate from the person whom Galen Marek had been.<ref name="Databank" /> The clone came to hate his genetic donor so much to the point where he was immensely proud of rising above the weaknesses that destroyed Marek. As a sign of his approval, and in order to prove that Marek was truly dead, Darth Vader revealed the preserved corpse of Galen Marek to the clone that he regarded as his new apprentice. Marek's body, hidden in a secret location within Timira City, confirmed what the clone already knew to be true: that he was indeed a clone and the real Galen Marek [[Battle on Death Star I|perished during his final stand against the]] [[Sith/Legends|Sith]].<ref name="DistantThunder">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]'': "Distant Thunder" cutscenes</ref>

Not long after Darth Vader finally deemed the project a success, Kamino was suddenly besieged by the entire [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|rebel fleet]]. By this time, Boba Fett returned to Kamino with Juno Eclipse as a hostage, in accordance with instructions from Vader.<ref name="TFU2vg" /> Due to Eclipse's presence on Timira City, Vader anticipated the arrival of the rebels, followed by the renegade clone who became known as "Starkiller", Galen Marek's Sith codename. Vader was confident that his Imperial forces were more than capable of defeating the fledgling Alliance in battle, but nevertheless he prepared for the inevitable confrontation with Marek's clone.<ref name="TFU2comic" /> In order to guarantee his own survival, however, he ordered his Dark Apprentice to remain hidden and to avoid intervening unless absolutely necessary;<ref name="DistantThunder" /> Boba Fett was also retained as a contingency asset in case Starkiller came too close to killing Vader.<ref name="TFU2comic" />

[[File:TFU2_duel.png|thumb|left|250px|The clone confronts his creator in Timira City.]]
Vader's plan, however, apparently backfired. With the aid of Starkiller and the leadership of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi General/Legends|General]] [[Rahm Kota/Legends|Rahm Kota]], the Rebel forces breached Kamino's [[Imperial Navy/Legends|naval defenses]] and stormed Timira City itself. The Rebel soldiers ultimately subdued the Imperial garrison, though not without sustaining severe casualties to their own numbers. Meanwhile, Starkiller fought and ultimately overpowered Vader in a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|duel]]. Though he was tempted to kill his creator, Starkiller reluctantly relented and allowed Kota to arrest the defeated Sith Lord;<ref name="TFU2vg" /> neither Boba Fett or the Dark Apprentice intervened.<ref name="TFU2comic" /><ref name="DistantThunder" /> Hence, the [[Assault on Kamino]] was secured as the Alliance's first major victory against the Empire in the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="TFU2vg" />

As the Alliance evacuated Kamino with their valuable hostage, they crashed the massive wreckage of [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]] into the ocean, intending to destroy all of Timira City and its cloning technology with the resulting tsunami, which was successful. Unknown to the rebels, and even Starkiller, Boba Fett secretly pursued them in [[Slave I/Legends|''Slave I'']] as they moved to transfer Darth Vader to the secret rebel base on [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]].<ref name="TFU2vg" />
